coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, wings across X, dorsal +Z. Default gliding pose centered origin; do not force airborne pose onto feet ground contact.

concept.reason: Museum diagnostic description plus primary fossil figure suffice; no extra generated concept.

scope: Whole organism, not isolated skull or generic renamed pterosaur.
specimen_basis: MIC-V241 juvenile complete skeleton illustrated in Burlot et al. 2024 Figure 2B1; MIC-V623 hindlimb in Figure 1. Adult whole-body silhouette is a composite reconstruction, not literal enlargement of juvenile measurements.

scale.basis: AMNH approximate 8-foot wingspan, adult artistic target, not juvenile MIC-V241 measured scale.

diagnostic_targets: Very elongated upward-curved jaw silhouette, slender rounded skull behind; no giant head crest.
Lower jaw carries dense slender filtering bristles; upper jaw teeth short and unobtrusive. Represent dense comb with simplified repeated thin geometry, not a row of large predator fangs.
Short-tailed pterodactyloid body, long wing-finger supported membranes, integrated hind limbs and feet. No feathers or bat-like multiple long support fingers.
Restrained earthy palette; do not claim speculative flamingo-pink coloration as established.
uncertainties: Wing membrane outline, soft tissue and colour inferred; neutral gliding pose is artistic.
Juvenile skeleton provides topology, not adult body proportions. Adult scale comes from museum account.
Stylized tooth count is deliberately reduced for performance, not claimed exact fossil count.
acceptance_checks: Side profile clearly shows upcurved slender long bill and bristle-comb lower jaw, not toothed pelican or straight spear beak.
Top/front shows both complete membrane wings without duplicated extra wing fingers; attach smoothly to body and hindlimb region.
Use 32–48 fine tooth segments per side if necessary for legibility/budget, declare approximation; no detached teeth.
Short tail, four main toes per hindfoot; no long diamond tail from Rhamphorhynchus.
Four default views only, perspective may reuse preview. Original geometry, no downloaded meshes/textures.
handoff_contract: Same directory prep/maker/QA. Maker reports files/hash COMPLETE then stops; no upload/cleanup. Root asynchronous backup, retain local for integration, restore Drive only if local absent. No PR for this candidate; hold for later batch.
